VV.zero_negative_handling: PASS - Linear values <= 0 are mapped to NaN in dB output. No infinities contaminate the output.
VV.note: dB conversion is verified on the georeferenced grid. The linear and dB outputs share the same CRS, transform, and dimensions. Float32 precision introduces ~0.003 dB quantization.
